placements.why: The content describes a mandatory onboarding procedure — an organizational process governing how new hires enter the institution. No existing strata or narrative leaf covers organizational procedures; this names the category the content calls for.
placements.title: Institutional procedures govern how people enter and integrate
placements.frame: What organizational processes and procedures shape how people enter, integrate into, and operate within the institution?

placements.title: Onboarding as ratified institutional procedure
placements.frame: How does a mandatory checklist function as the governing procedure that every new hire must complete in their first week?
placements.why: Both segments cohere under a shared theme: src-1 states the universal mandate and its three required components (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift), while src-2 grounds the checklist's institutional authority by noting it superseded the old wiki page. This names a subject — onboarding as governed procedure — that future envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact.
